patch.value: Release workflow publishes to npm before advancing protected main, desyncing npm from git

The daily release workflow runs Publish npm package before it advances git main. With main now a protected branch, the post-publish git push origin HEAD:main is rejected with GH006, so npm serves a version git main never reached and no tag exists for it. npm versions are immutable, so the only safe ordering is: advance main first (through a protected PR), verify it, then publish.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Fixed the inverted release ordering in .github/workflows/release.yml. Ported pm-changelog's invariant so an immutable npm artifact is never published before git main contains the release: added a 'Merge release metadata through protected PR' step (pushes release/<ver>, opens/reuses a PR, merges via the API with merge_method=rebase and the pinned release commit sha) and a 'Verify merged release' step (refetches origin/main, asserts the merged sha + package version, re-runs release:check, and git-diffs the touched files). Replaced 'Push release tag and main' (which did git push origin HEAD:main and hit GH006) with a tag-only 'Push release tag'. Added pull-requests: write to the workflow permissions and a base_sha output to the Decide step. The Verify git-diff list is package.json package-lock.json manifest.json index.ts CHANGELOG.md -- the files this repo's Commit release files step actually stages (dist/ is gitignored, src/ does not exist). Reference: fleet/pm-changelog/.github/workflows/release.yml.

patch.value: Added 'Merge release metadata through protected PR' and 'Verify merged release' steps between Check release ref and Publish npm package; replaced 'Push release tag and main' with tag-only 'Push release tag'; added pull-requests: write permission and a base_sha Decide output. Verify git-diff list adapted to this repo's committed release files (package.json package-lock.json manifest.json index.ts CHANGELOG.md).
npm publish runs only after git main already contains the verified release commit, so a GH006 protected-branch push rejection can never again leave npm ahead of git.

release.yml step order is now Commit release files -> Check release ref -> Merge release metadata through protected PR -> Verify merged release -> Publish npm package -> Push release tag -> Verify bun install -> Create GitHub release. Local quality gates (npm ci, build, test 69 pass, release:check) all green.

Reordered the daily release workflow so git main advances through a protected release PR and is re-verified BEFORE npm publish; the post-publish step is now tag-only instead of pushing HEAD:main. Ports pm-changelog's invariant into pm-linear.
